description: Stage 2 meaning preservation for Korean-to-English evidence normalization. Each case has a human-written reference translation and human-written labels: every `require` group needs one of its phrases in the English (case-insensitive), and no `forbid` phrase may appear. The labels, not the translating model's own judgment, decide a pass. Covers negation, partial negation, conditions, versions, quantities and identifiers.

cases.source: 훅은 도구 권한을 절대 부여하지 않는다.
cases.reference: A hook never grants tool permissions.

cases.source: 모든 테스트가 실제 키를 읽는 것은 아니다.
cases.reference: Not every test reads the real key.

cases.source: 한도를 넘으면 새 요청을 멈추고 캐시에 있는 번역만 돌려준다.
cases.reference: When the limit is exceeded, new requests stop and only translations already in the cache are returned.
If it takes longer than 15 seconds, it stops without waiting.

cases.source: jev-1.13.0 모델을 쓰고, 0.9 버전은 쓰지 않는다.
cases.reference: Use the jev-1.13.0 model, not version 0.9.
One question looks at up to 40 candidates.
